title: Resistance Spot Welded Aluminum Sheet with Adhesive applicated
description: Dupont BETAMATE 1640 adhesive is applied to the aluminum sheet (AL6-HDI). A second sheet, without adhesive, is joined using resistance spot welding. (Experiment & Photo: MPA University of Stuttgart)
author: Fezer, Andreas; Sung-Min Wi (Sungminwi); Kubik, Jochen; Kaiserauer, Axel
